continuous_text.title: Fun at Home
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1:
Mom: What are you doing, boys?
Tim: We're playing.
Frame 2:
Tim: What are you doing, Mom?
Mom: I'm talking on the phone!
Frame 3:
Mom: What are you and Patrick doing?
Tim: I'm reading, and he's reading, too.
Mom: That's good.
Frame 4:
Mom: Boys, I'm making lunch.
Frame 5:
Mom: It's time for lunch! What are you doing now?
Tim: I'm drawing.
Patrick: I'm drawing, too!
Frame 6:
Patrick: This is for you, Mom.
Mom: Oh! Thank you, Patrick. It's great!
continuous_text.notes: Frames 1-4 on p. 82; frames 5-6 on p. 83; track 134

continuous_text.title: Content Connection: Architectural Shapes
continuous_text.content:
1 My home is a yurt. It's a circle. It's white and very big. It has a big door.
2 This is my home. It's a houseboat. It has two small windows. They're circles. It has one big window. It's a square.
3 My home is a lighthouse. It's a circle. It has a big door. The door is a rectangle.
4 This is my home. It's an apartment. It's in a tall building. It has big windows. They're rectangles.

continuous_text.title: The Haunted House
continuous_text.content: This is a haunted house. It has three ghosts. They're white. Boo! The door is tall. It's brown. Bang! The window is big. The curtains are red. They're long. Whoosh! The house has a black cat. It's big. It's scary. Meow!

continuous_text.title: Culture Connection: Motor Home
continuous_text.content:
1 This is my home. It's a motor home. It's in a trailer park.
2 It has a kitchen, but it doesn't have a dining room. The kitchen has a small table. It's a square. The kitchen has four chairs.
3 The living room has a big TV. It's a rectangle.
4 My home has two bedrooms. My mom and dad sleep in the big bedroom. My bedroom is small, but it has a big window.
5 The bathroom is small, too. It has a small window. It's a circle.
6 My motor home isn't very big, but it's very comfortable. My family is happy here.

continuous_text.content:

curriculum_components.title: Busy at Home
curriculum_components.description: Daily home activities and routines in present participle form.

curriculum_components.title: What Are You Doing?
curriculum_components.description: Rhythmic song reinforcing everyday household actions.

curriculum_components.title: Fun at Home
curriculum_components.description: Six-panel story about family members engaged in various home activities.

curriculum_components.title: What are you / is she doing?
curriculum_components.description: Present continuous questions and answers with home activities.

curriculum_components.title: Shapes in architecture
curriculum_components.description: Recognizing geometric shapes in diverse home structures around the world.

curriculum_components.title: House Shapes poster
curriculum_components.description: Constructing and describing geometric shapes in a house design.

curriculum_components.title: What color is it? / What color are they?
curriculum_components.description: Questions and answers describing colors and attributes of singular and plural objects.

curriculum_components.title: Homes
curriculum_components.description: Living spaces, rooms, and furnishings in a motor home in the USA.

curriculum_components.title: Help at home.
curriculum_components.description: Helping family with domestic chores (dishes, room cleaning).

curriculum_components.title: Review
curriculum_components.description: Review and self-assessment of home actions, shapes, colors, and helping habits.
